svg.aria-label: Exactly specified teaching models. Shared response reduction to 80% gives 0.640 mg/L externally and 0.800 mg/L after ideal internal correction. Standard additions keep final volume and matrix constant. The final four checks have an extra 8% analyte-specific suppression, leaving 92% after internal correction; post-digestion spikes assess subsequent response.
